user.title: Connect Home Assistant MCP
user.description: {detected}. Use the MCP server on THIS Home Assistant instance with the Assist API and Control Home Assistant enabled. The URL is suggested automatically; enter a long-lived access token from your profile. [Set up MCP](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow/?domain=mcp_server).

engine.title: Connect the local Truss engine
engine.description: Install and start the Truss Local Engine app first, or run its Docker image on your own computer. It runs Laya locally. Choose bundled live transcription, an external sherpa-onnx streaming server, or an endpoint implementing the Truss streaming STT protocol. Standard Whisper upload and Ollama chat endpoints are not compatible. Wait until the engine log says its models are ready.

data.stt_url: External STT WebSocket URL (external mode only)

actions.title: Choose devices and execution threshold
actions.description: Select 1–24 entities, starting with 2–4 for lower latency. They must also be exposed to Assist in Settings > Voice assistants > Expose. Supported actions: on/off and scene/script activation. Actions execute during speech, once per utterance, when probability and the lead over the second candidate meet these thresholds. Scores are model estimates, not measured guarantees.

data.margin: Minimum lead over the next action (0–1)

error.cannot_connect_mcp: Could not discover compatible MCP tools. Check this HA instance's URL, token, Assist API, and Control Home Assistant setting.
error.cannot_connect_engine: Engine unavailable, models not ready, or invalid streaming endpoint. Check app logs, URL, and token.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Truss is already configured. Use its Configure button to change settings.

init.title: Configure Truss Live Voice
init.description: Changing settings reconnects Truss and stops active sessions. External transcription must use the selected sherpa-onnx or Truss streaming protocol. Entities must be exposed to Assist.

error.cannot_connect: Could not validate settings. Select 1–24 entities and check the MCP and engine endpoints, tokens, and model readiness.
